body.statement: Whenever \(\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(0)\ne\varnothing\), the support-enumerated set \(\widehat{\mathcal C}_{\mathrm{ad}}(Y_0,Y_1)\) is a measurable compact subset of \([-B,B]^N\), is computable by finitely many support-specific compact semialgebraic feasibility problems, is independent of \(\gamma\), and satisfies \(\inf_{\vartheta\in\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(0)}\Pr_\vartheta\{\beta\in\widehat{\mathcal C}_{\mathrm{ad}}(Y_0,Y_1)\}\ge0.95\). Empty and singleton outputs have Euclidean diameter zero. This guarantee includes positive-margin Gaussian instances with more affected units than the majority-valid-controls count in HeLiShiMiao2026 permits.
body.justification: A single set delivers finite-sample simultaneous coverage without a beta-min condition, support recovery, or known loading geometry.
body.gap: HeLiShiMiao2026 gives selection-based asymptotic coordinate inference under a majority-valid-controls count; this theorem gives finite-sample joint coverage on the stated Gaussian subclass throughout the unidentified union.
body.consumer: The construction yields joint and coordinate-projected uncertainty for the full RRSC interference map rather than isolated post-selection intervals.
